snippet.title: No Gods of Men - Reveal Trailer | Hand‑Drawn Roguevania + Base‑Building Colony Sim
snippet.description:
🔥 Wishlist on Steam ➜ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3599020/No_Gods_of_Men/

Hand‑drawn roguelike metroidvania meets base‑building colony sim — watch the No Gods of Men reveal now!

🔥 Wishlist on Steam ➜ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3599020/No_Gods_of_Men/
🖤 Join the Discord ➜ https://discord.gg/dTvJrkHzst

Dead Cells‑style action meets Cult of the Lamb‑inspired base‑building all in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Rebuild a towering citadel, recruit loyal disciples, and battle corrupted gods in this hand‑drawn 2D roguevania.

Features
• Hand‑drawn 2D art that brings a Saturday-morning cartoon charm to its dark fantasy world
• Roguelike metroidvania combat – hand-crafted realms, permadeath runs, tons of upgrade synergies
• Base‑building & colony management – build a citadel room-by-room and assign, manage, & sacrifice your disciples
• Disciples system – attract, nurture, and sacrifice followers for unique god‑powers and upgrades
• Narrative – uncover the fate of the seven golden gods and decide your realm's future

Platforms & Release
• PC (Steam) – Early Access planned for 2026

Press / Business
Press kit & contact ➜ https://www.nogodsofmen.com/press-kit

If you enjoyed Cult of the Lamb, Dead Cells, Moonlighter, or Fallout Shelter, hit that 👍, share the trailer, and tell us your favorite action roguelike and base-building features!

#Roguelike #Metroidvania #BaseBuilding #HandDrawn #NoGodsOfMen #indiegame #gamedeveloper #roguevania
